items.briefing:
There are no significant cybersecurity threats or incidents directly relevant to Australian organisations in today's articles. On the local industry front, Interactive has appointed Anneliese McDowell as its new cyber chief, signalling continued investment in cybersecurity leadership across the sector. Separately, Cohesity is highlighting the risks of "shadow AI" — staff using unauthorised AI tools at work — which is a growing concern for organisations of all sizes, including training providers.

**Practical tip:** Remind staff to only use AI tools that have been approved by your organisation, and to avoid entering sensitive student or business data into personal or unapproved AI platforms.

featured.title: Interactive appoints Anneliese McDowell as cyber chief
featured.quote: Local cyber leadership could improve incident response speed for Australian businesses facing escalating threats.
